root_cause: AG Grid debounceVerticalScrollbar was enabled, intentionally delaying viewport updates until scrolling settled
rowBuffer was reduced to 3, increasing visible row redraw during fast wheel/trackpad movement
AG Grid row hover background transitions added avoidable paint work while rows moved under a stationary pointer
fixes: removed animated background transition from AG Grid row surfaces while preserving hover state
added browser certification budget requiring later virtual rows to render within 350ms after a large viewport scroll
